race.comment: HE'SNOTALLTHERE (6) settled close to the speed last time out over this trip at Pinjarra and was only 1.5L off the winner. Pike hops on board now in a good push for his chances and he looks to be inching closer to a maiden win. Can get the job done now. DELICATE WARRIOR (3) steps straight out to this trip now from 1675m on the back of a nice performance at Bunbury last time out. A favourable barrier again this time is a big tick and his best form stands up. Can play a leading role. THANGOO (5) disappointed fresh before a strong performance as a $31 chance when out to 1700m last start, sticking on gamely from the front. CJP remains in the saddle as he steps out to 2200m third-up into the campaign and can sit up front again from the outset. Can go one better. YALDA NIGHT (2) is better than he showed last start and he won't be far away. SIN CITY BOY (4) has to be included despite going under as the favourite last time out.
